plan: Keep all patient-facing state in a single public `session` dictionary with exactly the four contract keys, rebuilt from one initial-state template on construction, begin, and abandon so resets are always clean.
Copy the appointments sequence at construction into id/label dictionaries plus an id set, giving O(1) validation of chosen/corrected appointment ids while preserving input order for choices.
Dispatch `handle` through a class-level table mapping the six action types to handler methods; anything else (non-dict actions, unknown types) short-circuits to an error screen.

Make every handler validate fully before mutating: shared `_require_in_progress` guard for active/incomplete-session actions, strict `isinstance(..., bool)` checks for confirmation values, and membership checks against the known-id set; guard failures return an `Error:`-prefixed screen and never raise or change state.
Build every screen through one `_screen` factory that emits exactly `prompt`, `messages`, `choices` and attaches copied appointment choices precisely when the prompt is `Choose appointment`.

Derive prompts from state with `_next_prompt` (unconfirmed contact -> `Confirm contact`, no appointment -> `Choose appointment`, else `Review and complete`) for corrections and error screens, while accepted begin/contact/choice/complete/abandon use the contract's fixed prompts and messages.

Expose the I/O seam as duck-typed `action_source.read_action()` and `screen_sink.display(screen)` attributes; `run_once` raises `RuntimeError` before touching either if one is missing, then performs exactly one read, one `handle`, one `display`, and returns the displayed screen object.
mechanisms: single authoritative session dictionary with template-based reset
handler dispatch table keyed by action type
guard-based validation before any state mutation, with non-raising Error: screens
centralized screen factory enforcing the fixed screen shape and the choices-only-on-Choose-appointment rule
state-derived next-unmet-prompt computation for corrections and error screens
constructor-time copy of appointments plus id set for order-preserving choices and O(1) id validation
dependency-injected action source and screen sink with a RuntimeError precheck in run_once for unittest fakes
